blocks.text: Sochiye aap motorcycle par ghar se nikle, pehle aage gaye, phir kuch wapas aaye. Meter (odometer) jo faasla dikhata hai woh kul chala hua raasta hai, lekin ghar se aap ki door kitni hai woh alag cheez hai. Is sabaq mein hum yahi do cheezein integration se nikalna seekhenge: displacement (position mein tabdeeli) aur distance (kul chala hua raasta).

Farz kijiye ek particle seedhi line par chal raha hai; us ka position function \(s(t)\), velocity function \(v(t)\) aur acceleration function \(a(t)\) hai. Kyun ke \(s'(t) = v(t)\) (position ka derivative velocity hai), Fundamental Theorem of Calculus se:

blocks.text_alt: the integral from t 1 to t 2 of v of t d t equals the integral of s dash of t d t, equals s of t evaluated from t 1 to t 2, equals s of t 2 minus s of t 1, equation 1

blocks.text: Isi tarah, kyun ke \(v'(t) = a(t)\) (velocity ka derivative acceleration hai), Fundamental Theorem of Calculus se:

blocks.text_alt: the integral from t 1 to t 2 of a of t d t equals v of t 2 minus v of t 1, equation 2

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
(1) ko lafzon mein parhiye: kisi waqt ke dauran velocity ka integral position mein tabdeeli deta hai, jise displacement kehte hain. (2) ko lafzon mein: acceleration ka integral velocity mein tabdeeli deta hai.
Yaani zanjeer (chain) yeh hai: position \(\xrightarrow{\text{differentiate}}\) velocity \(\xrightarrow{\text{differentiate}}\) acceleration. Integration isi zanjeer par ulta chalti hai. Har ulte qadam par ek constant aata hai, jise tay karne ke liye ek shuru wali value (\(v(0)\) ya \(s(0)\)) chahiye.
Khud sochiye: agar \(v(t)\) poore waqt positive ho to displacement aur distance mein koi farq hoga? (Nahin; farq tabhi aata hai jab particle kabhi wapas mude.)

Agar humein waqt ke dauran \([t_1, t_2]\) chala hua kul faasla (distance) nikalna ho, to woh waqfe (intervals) bhi dekhne honge jahan \(v(t) \ge 0\) (particle right ki taraf chal raha hai) aur woh bhi jahan \(v(t) \le 0\) (particle left ki taraf chal raha hai). Dono soorton mein distance \(|v(t)|\), yani speed, ko integrate kar ke nikalta hai. Is liye kul distance \(= \int_{t_1}^{t_2} |v(t)|\,dt\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kul distance ko \(\int_{t_2}^{t_1} v(t)\,dt\) chhapti hai: limits ulti hain aur modulus (\(|\ |\)) ghayab hai. Jaisa pichle jumle mein kaha gaya, distance speed \(|v(t)|\) ka integral hai. Sahi: kul distance \(= \int_{t_1}^{t_2} |v(t)|\,dt\).

blocks.alt: Velocity curve v(t) against time t, starting at t1 and ending at t2 on the t-axis. It rises above the axis (shaded area A1), dips below the axis (shaded area A2) and rises above it again (shaded area A3).
blocks.caption: Figure 23: displacement and distance as areas under a velocity curve (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Yeh figure dikhati hai ke displacement aur distance dono ko velocity curve ke neeche ke areas ki shakal mein kaise samjha ja sakta hai. \(A_1\) aur \(A_3\) axis ke upar hain (particle right ja raha hai), aur \(A_2\) axis ke neeche hai (particle left aa raha hai).

blocks.text_alt: Displacement equals the integral from t 1 to t 2 of v of t d t, equals A 1 minus A 2 plus A 3
Distance equals the integral from t 1 to t 2 of the modulus of v of t d t, equals A 1 plus A 2 plus A 3

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab doosri line mein \(\text{Distance} = \int_{t_1}^{t_2} v(t)\,dt\) chhapti hai, jo bilkul displacement wala integral hai. Sahi \(\text{Distance} = \int_{t_1}^{t_2} |v(t)|\,dt = A_1 + A_2 + A_3\) hai: \(|v|\) lene se axis ke neeche wala hissa upar palat jata hai, is liye \(A_2\) minus hone ki bajaye plus hota hai.

blocks.caption: Displacement aur distance ka muqabla (hamara khulasa)
rows: Axis ke neeche wale areas minus: \(A_1 - A_2 + A_3\)
Positive, negative ya zero ho sakta hai
Jahan \(v(t)\) ka sign badle wahan interval torein

blocks.text: Figure ko ek aur nazar se dekhiye. Har chhote waqt \(\delta t\) mein particle taqreeban \(v(t)\,\delta t\) chalta hai; yeh curve ke neeche ek patli patti (strip) ka area hai. Jab \(v\) positive ho to patti axis ke upar hai aur particle right jata hai; jab \(v\) negative ho to patti axis ke neeche hai aur particle left aata hai. Saari pattiyan sign ke saath jama karein to displacement milta hai; sign hata kar (sab ko positive maan kar) jama karein to distance milta hai. Isi liye distance nikalne ka sab se pehla qadam hamesha yeh hai: "\(v(t) = 0\) kahan hai?" Wahi points batate hain ke particle kahan mura (turn kiya).

Ab kitab ki misaal dekhte hain. Is mein teeno cheezein ek saath hain: acceleration se velocity, phir displacement, phir distance. Har part ko alag rule chahiye, is liye har qadam par "kyun" par khaas dhyan dijiye.

blocks.title: Example 68
blocks.problem:
A particle moves along a straight line with acceleration \(a(t) = 6t - 18\) (m/s\(^2\)) and initial velocity \(v(0) = 15\) m/s.
(a) Find the velocity function \(v(t)\).
(b) Find the displacement of the particle during \(0 \le t \le 3\).
(c) Find the total distance traveled during \(0 \le t \le 3\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(a(t) = 6t - 18\) m/s\(^2\), \(v(0) = 15\) m/s.
Maloom karna: (a) \(v(t)\); (b) \([0, 3]\) par displacement; (c) \([0, 3]\) par kul distance.
Tareeqa: velocity, acceleration ka antiderivative hai, aur shuru wali velocity \(v(0)\) constant tay karti hai. Displacement \(\int v\,dt\) hai; distance \(\int |v|\,dt\) hai, is liye \([0, 3]\) ko wahan torna hoga jahan \(v\) ka sign badalta hai.

(a) Acceleration ko integrate karein
\[v(t) = \int a(t)\,dt = \int (6t - 18)\,dt\]
\[= 6\dfrac{t^{2}}{2} - 18t + c\]
\[= 3t^{2} - 18t + c\]
jahan \(c\) constant of integration hai.
Kyun: \(v'(t) = a(t)\), yani \(v\) woh function hai jis ka derivative \(a\) hai. Power rule: \(\int t\,dt = \frac{t^{2}}{2}\), aur \(\int 18\,dt = 18t\). Yahan indefinite integral (bina limits) likha hai, kyun ke constant \(c\) sirf indefinite integral mein aata hai (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).

(a) Shuru wali velocity lagayein
\[v(0) = 3(0)^{2} - 18(0) + c\]
\[15 = c\]
\[v(t) = 3t^{2} - 18t + 15\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par \(c\) ke ilawa har term zero ho jati hai, is liye \(c\) bilkul shuru wali velocity ke barabar hai.

(b) \(0 \le t \le 3\) par displacement
\[S = \int_{0}^{3} (3t^{2} - 18t + 15)\,dt\]
\[= \big[t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 15t\big]_{0}^{3}\]
\[= 27 - 81 + 45 = -9\]
Matlab particle 9 m left (baayen) taraf khisak gaya.
Kyun: equation (1) ke mutabiq \(\int_{0}^{3} v\,dt = s(3) - s(0)\), yani position mein tabdeeli. Minus sign ka matlab hai ke aakhri position shuru se 9 m left hai. Yeh faasla nahin, balke "kahan se kahan pahuncha" hai.

(c) \(v\) ka sign kahan badalta hai?
\[v(t) = 3(t^{2} - 6t + 5)\]
\[= 3(t - 1)(t - 5)\]
Is liye \([0, 1]\) par \(v(t) \ge 0\) aur \([1, 3]\) par \(v(t) \le 0\).
Kyun: distance har woh meter ginta hai jo chala gaya, chahe right ho ya left, is liye \(|v|\) chahiye. Roots 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan \((t - 1)\) positive aur \((t - 5)\) negative hai, to \(v \le 0\). Misaal ke taur par \(t = 2\): \(v = 3(1)(-3) = -9 < 0\).
Dhyan dein: sign check kiye baghair seedha \(\int_{0}^{3} v\,dt\) ko distance likh dena sab se aam ghalti hai.

(c) Integral ko do hisson mein torein
\[\int_{0}^{3}|v(t)|\,dt = \int_{0}^{1} v(t)\,dt + \int_{1}^{3}\big(-v(t)\big)\,dt\]
\[= \big[t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 15t\big]_{0}^{1} - \big[t^{3} - 9t^{2} + 15t\big]_{1}^{3}\]
Kyun: \([1, 3]\) par \(v\) negative hai, is liye wahan \(|v| = -v\). Minus lagane se negative hissa positive ban kar jama hota hai.

(c) Hisaab lagayein
\[= \big[(1 - 9 + 15) - 0\big] - \big[(27 - 81 + 45) - (1 - 9 + 15)\big]\]
\[= 7 - (-9 - 7)\]
\[= 7 - (-16) = 7 + 16 = 23\text{ m}\]
Kyun: particle pehle second mein 7 m right gaya, phir agle do seconds mein 16 m left aaya. Kul chala hua raasta \(7 + 16 = 23\) m.

Tasdeeq:
Displacement \(= 7 - 16 = -9\) m, jo part (b) se milta hai. Distance \(= 23\) m, jo \(|{-9}| = 9\) se bara hai, aur hona bhi chahiye, kyun ke distance kabhi displacement ke size se kam nahin hota.
blocks.answer: (a) \(v(t) = 3t^{2} - 18t + 15\) m/s. (b) Displacement \(= -9\) m (9 m left). (c) Kul distance \(= 23\) m.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab \(v(t) = \int_{0}^{t} a(t)\,dt = \dots + c\) likhti hai. \(0\) se \(t\) tak ke definite integral mein constant of integration nahin hota; woh \(v(t) - v(0)\) deta hai, \(v(t)\) nahin. Sahi: \(v(t) = \int a(t)\,dt = 3t^{2} - 18t + c\) (indefinite integral), ya \(v(t) = v(0) + \int_{0}^{t} a(u)\,du\). Dono se \(v(t) = 3t^{2} - 18t + 15\) aata hai, is liye kitab ka aakhri jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 69 kitab ne 3.8.2 ke neeche chhapi hai lekin yeh motion ka sawal nahin. Is mein wahi idea kisi bhi rate par lagaya gaya hai: agar \(P'(t)\) tabdeeli ka rate (rate of change) hai, to \(\int_{t_1}^{t_2} P'(t)\,dt = P(t_2) - P(t_1)\) kul tabdeeli hai. Jaise tanki mein paani bharne ka rate ho to integral kul paani deta hai, ya aamdani ka rate ho to kul kamai.

blocks.title: Example 69
blocks.problem:
Growth rate of population: A town's population growth rate (in people per year) is given by \(P'(t) = 5000 + 200t\), where \(t\) is the number of years after 2020. If the population in 2020 (\(t = 0\)) was 100,000:
(a) Find the population function \(P(t)\). (b) What will the population be in 2030? (c) Find the total population increase from 2022 to 2028.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P'(t) = 5000 + 200t\) log fi saal, \(t\) = 2020 ke baad ke saal, \(P(0) = 100{,}000\).
Maloom karna: (a) \(P(t)\); (b) 2030 mein aabadi; (c) 2022 se 2028 tak izafa.
Tareeqa: \(P\) rate \(P'\) ka antiderivative hai; 2020 ki aabadi constant tay karti hai. Do saalon ke darmiyan tabdeeli \(P(t_2) - P(t_1) = \int_{t_1}^{t_2} P'(t)\,dt\) hai.

(a) Population function
\[P(t) = \int P'(t)\,dt = \int (5000 + 200t)\,dt\]
\[P(t) = 5000t + 100t^{2} + C\]
Kyun: \(\int 5000\,dt = 5000t\) aur \(\int 200t\,dt = 200\cdot\frac{t^{2}}{2} = 100t^{2}\). Rate ka integral asal miqdaar deta hai, bas ek constant ke saath.

(a) \(P(0) = 100000\) lagayein
\[100000 = 0 + 0 + C \Rightarrow C = 100000\]
\[P(t) = 100000 + 5000t + 100t^{2}\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par sirf \(C\) bachta hai, is liye \(C\) shuru ki aabadi hai.

(b) 2030 ki aabadi
\(2030 \to t = 10\) (yani 10 saal)
\[P(10) = 100000 + 5000(10) + 100(100)\]
\[= 100000 + 50000 + 10000\]
\[= 160000\text{ log}\]
Kyun: \(t\) 2020 ke baad ke saal ginta hai, is liye 2030 matlab \(t = 10\).
Dhyan dein: \(t = 2030\) rakh dena ghalat hai.

(c) 2022 se 2028 tak izafa
\(2022 \to t_1 = 2\) aur \(2028 \to t_2 = 8\)
\[\text{Increase} = P(8) - P(2)\]
\[P(8) = 100000 + 5000(8) + 100(64) = 146400\]
\[P(2) = 100000 + 5000(2) + 100(4) = 110400\]
\[\text{Increase} = 146400 - 110400 = 36000\]
Kyun: izafa = baad wali aabadi minus pehle wali aabadi. Fundamental Theorem ke mutabiq yeh \(\int_{2}^{8} P'(t)\,dt\) ke barabar bhi hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[\int_{2}^{8}(5000 + 200t)\,dt = \big[5000t + 100t^{2}\big]_{2}^{8}\]
\[= 46400 - 10400 = 36000\]
Wahi jawab, aur is mein \(C\) ki zaroorat bhi nahin pari (definite integral mein constant cancel ho jata hai).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Ek gaari ki velocity \(v(t) = 4 - 2t\) m/s hai. \(0 \le t \le 3\) par displacement aur distance nikaliye.
Displacement: \(\int_{0}^{3}(4 - 2t)\,dt = [4t - t^{2}]_{0}^{3} = 12 - 9 = 3\) m.
Sign: \(v = 0\) jab \(t = 2\). \([0, 2]\) par \(v \ge 0\), \([2, 3]\) par \(v \le 0\).
Distance: \([4t - t^{2}]_{0}^{2} - [4t - t^{2}]_{2}^{3} = 4 - (3 - 4) = 4 + 1 = 5\) m.
Yani gaari 4 m aage gayi, 1 m wapas aayi: displacement 3 m, distance 5 m. Dekhiye, agar hum interval na torte to sirf 3 m milta, jo distance ka ghalat jawab hota.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\int_{t_1}^{t_2} v\,dt = s(t_2) - s(t_1)\) (displacement); \(\int_{t_1}^{t_2} a\,dt = v(t_2) - v(t_1)\).
2. Distance \(= \int_{t_1}^{t_2} |v(t)|\,dt\): pehle \(v = 0\) wali jagah dhoondiye, interval toriye, aur jahan \(v < 0\) ho wahan \(-v\) lijiye.
3. Acceleration se velocity: integrate karein, phir \(v(0)\) se constant; velocity se position: dobara integrate karein aur \(s(0)\) lagayein.
4. Har rate ke liye yahi tareeqa: kul tabdeeli \(= \int\) rate \(dt\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Distance poocha jaye aur displacement de dena: Example 68 mein displacement \(-9\) m hai magar distance 23 m.
2. Constant of integration bhool jana, ya shuru wali value se use tay na karna.
3. \(v(t)\) ke zero par interval na torna, jis se left wali harkat right wali harkat ko cancel kar deti hai.
4. \(t\) ki jagah saal likh dena: 2028 ka matlab \(t = 8\) hai, \(t = 2028\) nahin.
